_comment: Halo settings. Edit with `halo config edit`, then `halo restart` -- these are read once when the engine starts. The vocabulary files beside this one (dictionary/snippets/commands) DO reload while running. Any value here can be overridden for one run with an environment variable: HALO_HOTKEY, HALO_LANGUAGE, HALO_MODEL, HALO_THREADS, HALO_OVERLAY, HALO_PRIVACY, HALO_WHISPER_BIN.
_comment_whisper_bin: Absolute path to whisper-cli, filled in by `halo setup`. Leave empty to search PATH and the usual Homebrew prefixes -- but note launchd gives the background agent a bare PATH, so the absolute path is what makes it work at login.
_comment_privacy: Privacy Mode at startup. On means the OpenRouter call is skipped entirely and the raw local transcript is injected. Saying 'privacy on' flips it at runtime and that choice persists.

cleanup._comment: Optional LLM pass that adds punctuation and removes fillers. Needs an OpenRouter key (`halo key set`). Without one, Halo injects the raw transcript and nothing leaves your Mac. Models are tried in order when one rate-limits or times out.
